description: Create a Zendesk group with an account-unique name to organize agents for ticket assignment and routing. Returns the group's assigned ID and supported group fields.

inputSchema.description: Request model for creating a new Zendesk group.

description.description: An optional description of the group explaining its purpose or responsibilities
examples: Handles all tier-1 customer support tickets
description.human_parameter_description: Optional description of the group's purpose
description.title: Description

is_public.description: If true, the group is public and visible to all agents. If false, the group is private. Note: You cannot change a private group to a public group after creation.
is_public.human_parameter_description: Set to true for public groups visible to all agents, false for private groups
is_public.title: Is Public

name.description: The name of the group. Must be unique within the account. Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed.
name.human_parameter_description: The name for the new group. This is how it will appear in Zendesk for your agents.
name.title: Name

inputSchema.title: CreateZendeskGroupRequest

name: create_zendesk_group

ZendeskGroupResponse.description: Response model representing a Zendesk group.

created_at.description: The time the group was created in ISO 8601 format
created_at.title: Created At

default.description: If true, this is the default group for the account
default.title: Default

deleted.description: If true, the group has been deleted
deleted.title: Deleted

id.description: Automatically assigned unique identifier for the group
id.title: Id

is_public.description: If true, the group is public
is_public.title: Is Public

updated_at.description: The time of the last update of the group in ISO 8601 format
updated_at.title: Updated At

url.description: The API URL of the group
url.title: Url

ZendeskGroupResponse.title: ZendeskGroupResponse
